linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (or equivalent 64-bit distro)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz dual-core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2-compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM (Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA 600 series / AMD HD 7000 series)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (or equivalent modern distro)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.5+ GHz quad-core) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM or better, Vulkan/OpenGL 4.5 support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA/PulseAudio compatible with stereo output

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz dual-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (1 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated macOS-compatible audio (CoreAudio)
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.5+ GHz quad-core) or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (AMD Radeon Pro 560 or better) / Apple M1 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated CoreAudio (external card optional for higher quality)
